step1.title: Welcome to Tailoring
step1.description: Upload an existing resume to get started. We'll extract your details and fit them perfectly to your target job.

step2.title: Upload Area
step2.description: Drag & drop your PDF or DOCX file here.

step3.title: Add Manually or Select
step3.description: Alternatively, type your details manually or select a previously saved resume.

step4.title: Track Progress
step4.description: Follow the steps here from uploading to reviewing data and generating your final resume.

step1.title: Confirm Core Details
step1.description: Start here and make sure your name and email are accurate. Correct core details improve matching quality downstream.

step2.title: Polish Sections
step2.description: Review experience, projects, and skills for clarity and impact. Add missing items before generating.

step3.title: Continue to Tailoring
step3.description: Use Add Section if something important is missing, then continue when required fields are complete.

step1.title: Target Job Context
step1.description: Paste the target job description with enough detail. Better input here gives better tailoring results.

step2.title: Import from Job URL
step2.description: You can paste a job post URL to auto-fill the description, then quickly refine the imported text.

step3.title: Optional Enhancements
step3.description: Enable only the extras you need now, like Cover Letter, Interview Prep, or Career Roadmap.

step4.title: Generate Tailored Output
step4.description: When your job description is ready, run tailoring to produce your optimized resume and add-ons.

step1.title: Download Your Resume
step1.description: Export your tailored resume in PDF or DOCX. Save both if you need different application formats.

step2.title: Refine and Regenerate
step2.description: Use Edit Sections for content fixes or Regenerate Variant to try a different optimization pass.

step3.title: Check ATS Improvement
step3.description: Review before/after score and missing keywords to decide where to strengthen alignment.

step4.title: Preview Before Sending
step4.description: Scan the full resume preview for formatting, content quality, and personal details before sharing.

step5.title: Use Extra Outputs
step5.description: If enabled, open Cover Letter, Interview Prep, and Career Roadmap tabs to prepare beyond the CV.

step1.title: The Resume Builder
step1.description: This is where the magic happens. Your extracted information is mapped directly into our templates.

step2.title: Save & Upload
step2.description: Don't forget to save your progress, or upload a new source document if needed.

step3.title: Content Editor
step3.description: Edit your experience, education, and skills. Every change reflects instantly.

step4.title: Design Settings
step4.description: Unlock your personal brand here. You can swap between professional templates instantly, fine-tune your base and accent color palette, select premium font pairings, and adjust paragraph spacing to ensure your CV stands out perfectly.

step5.title: Export Options
step5.description: Download your finished resume as a high-quality PDF or DOCX, ready for applications.

step6.title: Live Preview
step6.description: See how your resume looks in real-time as you type or change designs.

step1.title: Developer Hub
step1.description: Manage your API keys to integrate our resume engine into your own applications.

step2.title: Generate a Key
step2.description: Create a new API key here. Keep it secret!

step3.title: Your Active Keys
step3.description: View, copy, or revoke your existing keys here.

step1.title: Quick Navigation
step1.description: Access the core tools: resumes, upload, and analytics directly from the sidebar.
